name: capcut-sfx-learning
description: Personal CapCut SFX, zooms and intro text hooks with seven-day analysis reuse, revision learning and component edit modes.

interface.longDescription: Analyze each video once and reuse verified local analysis for seven days. Design SFX, reaction zooms and native intro text hooks together or separately, preserve manual settings and learn from revisions.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use full combo edit for these timelines: SFX, reaction zooms and the intro text hook in my native settings. Reuse seven-day analysis and learn revisions. Support just sfx, just zoom, just text hook, or full combo edit when I select a mode.
